The following copy of a letter received by the
Commissioner of Police from the Japanese Consulate is
forwarded for information.

"July 24, 1930.

Re information on two Lithuanian subjects.

Sir,
I beg to inform you that I have received a letter from
the Procurator's Office of the District Court of the Kwantung
Government at Dairen which informs me that the following two
Lithuanians are suspects in connection with a larceny case.

Name            Ruzel Futskus
Age             33
Profession      Pedlar of clothing
Address         No. 160 East Seward Road, Shanghai.

Name            Haskel Revid
Age             28
Address         No. 15 Dent Road, Shanghai.
Profession      Musician

The following information is requested regarding these
two persons by the Procurator's Office of the District
Court of the Kwantung Government at Dairen.
1. Name
2. Age
3. Nationality
4. Address
5. Profession
6. Financial condition
7. Present conducts and history of their life
8. Previous conviction
9. Number of family if they have any
10. Other remarks

According to reports they are living in the Settlement
but it is difficult to make enquiries about them therefore
the police will be very thankful if you can supply any
information regarding the abovementioned persons."

The first mentioned person's real name is Leon A. Fuckn
alias Fuchs alias Fooks alias Fox, Russian Jew. He has been
previously charged as follows:-

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S. B. D 1486
Special Branch No. 2. Station,
REPORT
Date August 1, 1930.
Subject (in full) L.A. Fucks and Haskel Levit.
Made by ______ and ______ Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,
With reference to attached letter from the local
Japanese Consular Police dated July 24th 1930 re: (1)
Ruzel Futskus and (2) Haskel Revid, enquiries show that
their real names are (1) Leon A. Fucks alias Fuchs alias
Fooks alias Fox. (2) Haskel Levit alias Gevit.
Leon A. Fucks, who is a Russian jew but claims to be
a Lithuanian subject, arrived in Shanghai several years
ago from North China and has resided in different low
class boarding houses in the Wayside district. He is
married but lives apart from his wife who is now residing
in the French Concession. He gave out that he was engaged
peddling cloth and although it was known that he did not
do any business in that line, he appeared at times to be
fairly well off financially. Fucks is nothing but a common
criminal and has been charged as under:-
Provisional Court, Pickpocket, dismissed 3-6-29.
- do - - do - 50 days 7-9-29.
- do - Larceny, 30 days 8-11-29.
He left Shanghai for Dairen on June 13th 1930.
Haskel Levit, Russian jew, claims to be a Lithuanian
subject, arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in 1922 and with
the exception of short visits to Northern ports has resided
here since that date. He claims to be a fur dealer and
musician but was never known to do any legitimate business.
He is not married and like Fucks appears to be fairly well
off at times.
Levit has been charged as under:-
Mixed Court, Larceny from person, 3 months, 23-3-23.

先生，
关于附上的当地日本领事馆警察1930年7月24日来信，涉及：(1) Ruzel Futskus 和 (2) Haskel Revid，经查询显示，他们的真实姓名是 (1) Leon A. Fucks，别名 Fuchs，别名 Fooks，别名 Fox。(2) Haskel Levit，别名 Gevit。
Leon A. Fucks 是俄籍犹太人，但自称是立陶宛籍臣民，数年前从华北抵达上海，一直居住在虹口地区各类低档寄宿公寓中。他已婚，但与妻子分居，其妻现居住在法租界。他声称从事布料小贩生意，虽然众所周知他并未从事该行当，但他有时看起来经济相当宽裕。Fucks 不过是个普通罪犯，被指控情况如下：-
临时法院，扒窃，驳回，1929年6月3日。
- 同上 - - 同上 - 50天，1929年9月7日。
- 同上 - 盗窃罪，30天，1929年11月8日。
他于1930年6月13日离开上海前往大连。
Haskel Levit，俄籍犹太人，自称是立陶宛籍臣民，1922年从哈尔滨抵达上海，除短暂访问北方港口外，自那时起一直居住在此。他自称是皮草商人和音乐家，但从未见其从事任何正当生意。他未婚，像 Fucks 一样，有时看起来经济相当宽裕。
Levit 被指控情况如下：-
混合法庭，人身盗窃，3个月，1923年3月23日。

October 12, 32.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter No. C.I.D. 576/1931 and enclosure of October 5
on the subject of Luzar Abraham Fuchs and to forward
herewith a copy of his criminal record and photograph
together with those of his known associates: Eugene
Salnik, Abraham Brodski, Yan Movachinsky, Maria
Pasderska, Antonine Bootkova, Elizabeth Gavrilkin,
Katherina V. Komassarava and W.A. Tzetzenkevich.

L.A. Fuchs who is a Russian Jew, but claims to be
a Lithuanian subject, arrived in Shanghai several years
ago from North China and has resided in various low class
boarding houses in the Eastern District of Shanghai.
He is a married man, and in 1930 was living apart from his
wife, who at that time lived in the French Concession.
Fuchs is supposed to be pedler of cloth, but has never
been known to do any business, although at times he
appeared to be fairly well off financially.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

Director of Criminal Intelligence,
Police Headquarters,
SHANGHAI.

POLICE HEADQUARTERS.
HONG KONG.

5th October, 1932.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that a Russian named
Luzar Abraham Fuchs, aged 35 years, was observed in company with
three other aliens in the shopping centre of this Colony on the
30th September, 1932. One of Fuchs associates named Salnik, who
is minus the fingers of his right hand, was identified as a
professional shop lifter in Tientsin and elsewhere in North China.
Fuchs was arrested but the other three made good their escape.
He is in possession of a Chinese passport, Registered Number 7321/31,
No.652 issued in Shanghai on 4.12.31, bearing visa by H.B.M.
Consul General Canton, dated 29th September, 1932, for Shanghai via
Hong Kong, by the s.s."President Cleveland". He had no other
papers and no money.

He informed the Police that Salnik was in possession of
sufficient money to pay their fares to Shanghai by the "President
Cleveland" sailing on the 1st October. The Police were unsuccessful
in their efforts to trace Fuchs' confederates and none of them left
by the "President Cleveland". Fuch is being detained here with a
view to his banishment. He admits having served three terms of
imprisonment in Shanghai Gaol for shop lifting.

I enclose copy of his finger prints and photograph which
may enable you to trace his previous record, and request the favour
of

The Deputy Commissioner (Crime),
Shanghai Municipal Council,
S H A N G H A I.

（印：CRIME BRANCH）

1932年10月5日。

先生，

谨此告知，1932年9月30日，在本殖民地的购物中心观察到一名名为 Luzar Abraham Fuchs、35岁的俄罗斯人与其他三名外籍人士在一起。Fuchs 的一名同伙名为 Salnik，右手手指缺失，被确认为天津及华北其他地区的专业商店行窃犯。Fuchs 被捕，但其他三人成功逃脱。他持有一本中国护照，注册号 7321/31，编号652，1931年12月4日在上海签发，持有英国驻华广东总领事于1932年9月29日签发的签证，目的地为经香港乘“克利夫兰总统号”轮船前往上海。他没有其他证件和钱财。

他告诉警方，Salnik 拥有足够的钱支付他们乘坐10月1日启航的“克利夫兰总统号”前往上海的船费。警方未能追踪到 Fuchs 的同伙，他们均未乘坐“克利夫兰总统号”离开。Fuchs 正被拘留于此，拟将其驱逐出境。他承认曾因商店行窃在上海监狱服刑三次。

随函附上他的指纹和照片副本，以便贵方查找其既往记录，并恳请

副总监（刑事），
上海公共租界工部局，
上 海。

5th October,1932. 


Sir, 
I have the honour to inform you that a Russian named 
Luzar Abraham Fuchs, aged 35 years, was observed in company with 


three other aliens in the shopping centre of this Colony on the 


30th September,1932. One of Fuchs associates named Sainik, who 

is minus the fingers of his right hand, was identified as a 
professional shop lifter in Tientsin and elsewhere in North China. 
Fuchs was arrested but the other three made good their escape. 

He is in possession of a Chinese passport,Registered Number 7321/31, 
No.652 issued in Shanghai on 4.12.31, bearing visa by H.B.M. 

Consul Genera] Canton, dated 29th September,1932, for Shanghai via 
Hong Kong, by the s.s."President Cleveland". He had no other 
papers and no money. 

He informed the Police that Salnik was in possession of 
sufficient money to pay their fares to Shanghai by the "President 
Cleveland” sailing on the lst October. The Police were unsuccessful 
in their efforts ‘to trace Fuchs’ confederates and none of them left 
by the "President Cleveland". Fuch is being detained here with a 
view to his baihsment. He admits having served three terms of 
imprisonment in Shanghai Gaol for shop lifting. 

I enclose copy of his finger prints and photograph which 


may enable you to trace his previous record, and request the favour 


of
